Short title and Commencement

SINDH UNIVERSITIES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH UNIVERSITIES
LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend certain laws relating to the Universities in force in the Province of
Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th June, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(17)/2002,
dated 15-6-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
Commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Universities
Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 20 of the Sindh Acts XXIV and XXV of 1972

SINDH UNIVERSITIES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH UNIVERSITIES
LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend certain laws relating to the Universities in force in the Province of
Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th June, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(17)/2002,
dated 15-6-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 20 of
the Sindh Acts XXIV and XXV of 1972.---In the University of Sindh Act, 1972
and in the University of Karachi Act, 1972, in section 20, in subsection (3),
for the words "twice in every year on date", the words "once a
year on date' shall be substituted.

3. Amendment of section 13 of
Sindh Acts III, IV, and V of 1977 and XIX of 1996.---In the N.E.D.
University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977, in the Mehran University of
Engineering and Technology Act, 1977, in the Sindh Agricultural University Act,
1977, and in the Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering and Technology
Nawabshah Act, 1996, in section 13, in subsection (4), for the words
"twice a year on the dates", the words "once a year on the
date" shall be substituted.
